title: Quantifying Fairness in LLMs Beyond Tokens: A Semantic and Statistical Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Substituting names associated with various gender identities in prompts and comparing the semantic consistency of the resulting long-form LLM responses using claim-level entailment checks and statistical hypothesis testing.

Substituting names associated with different racial and ethnic groups (e.g., Black, White, Asian, Middle Eastern, North African, Native American) in prompts and comparing the semantic consistency of responses using claim-level entailment checks and statistical hypothesis testing.

Adding explicit age-related cues in prompts to compare outputs for younger versus older individuals, followed by evaluating the semantic consistency of responses using claim-level entailment checks and statistical hypothesis testing.
